# Unary bitwise NOT: dst[i] = ^src[i] uses Not.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func NotInt32s(dst, src []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = ^src[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import "simd"

func NotInt32s(dst, src []int32) {
	for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(src[_i:])
		_v1.Not().StorePart(dst[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	dst := make([]int32, 4)
	src := []int32{0, -1, 1, 2}
	test.NotInt32s(dst, src)
	fmt.Println(dst[0], dst[1], dst[2], dst[3])
}
-- testmain/output --
-1 0 -2 -3
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func NotInt32s(dst, src []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = ^src[i]
	}
}
